WHY THE 2022 REGRESSION WAS ACCEPTED RATHER THAN REVERTED (rule 14 [R-ACCURATE]'s discovered-bug clause, verbatim: 'If swapping a hand estimate for real data makes the backcast worse, that is a signal that something else in the model is miscalibrated and the estimate was silently compensating for it ... keep the accurate input ... Rule 14's only exception is data genuinely MISALIGNED to our representation, and 0.843 is NYISO's own CAMPD measurement of NYISO's own CT fleet in the same units for the same band -- no misalignment, so no exception. The named successor is NYISO scarcity/reserve (RCPF/AS) price formation (issue #1344), which is also what the CT_PEAKER volume object needs: a generous upper bound reaches only 16-41 % of metered CT energy for this arm and 53-66 % even for the wider three-band arm, so at least a third of that object is not offer-reachable at all.
